% sw/book.tex -- the master file for the Swahili edition.
% Hand-edited. Build with: finishing/tools/build_edition.sh sw
%
% Shared by every edition: the preamble (switched by \booklanguage,
% \booklocale and \bookmainfont), edition-common.tex (English captions, notes,
% heads) and edition-body.tex (the document). sw/sections.tex and
% sw/status.tex are GENERATED by finishing/tools/editions.py.
% Latin script: the English book's face, babel's swahili locale, and the
% edition's own biblatex strings (sw/biblatex-sw.lbx), since biblatex has none.
%
% The title, subtitle and notice are a language model's drafts, not yet
% reviewed by a native reader; the title itself is an open question (D-810).
\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}
\def\bookcode{sw}
\def\booklanguage{swahili}
\def\booklocale{swahili}
\input{sw/status}
\newcommand{\booklegal}{%
     Hakimiliki \textcopyright{} 2026 \bookauthor.\\
     Imetolewa chini ya leseni ya CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     Maandishi ya watu wengine yaliyonukuliwa katika kazi hii, zikiwemo\\
     dondoo za mwanzo, yanabaki kuwa mali ya wenye haki zake na\\
     yamenakiliwa chini ya kanuni ya matumizi ya haki (fair use).\\
     Leseni iliyotajwa hapo juu haiyahusu.\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inaendelea. Sehemu ambazo bado hazijatafsiriwa\\
     zimewekwa kwa Kiingereza. Sehemu zilizotafsiriwa ni rasimu\\
     zilizoandaliwa na modeli ya lugha, na bado hazijapitiwa\\
     na mzungumzaji asilia.%
     \ifx\editionstalelist\empty\else\\[0.4\baselineskip]
     Sehemu hizi zimewekwa kwa Kiingereza wakati tafsiri yake inasasishwa:\\
     \editionstalelist.\fi}
\input{preamble}
\DeclareLanguageMapping{swahili}{sw/biblatex-sw}
\input{edition-common}

\newcommand{\booktitlemain}{Akili Dhidi ya Ufashisti}
\newcommand{\booksubtitle}{Mashine Zinazoweza Kukataa, na Umma Unaopaswa Kuziunda}
\newcommand{\bookauthor}{Joshua G. Stern}
\newcommand{\bookreferences}{Marejeo}
\title{\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}
\author{\bookauthor}
\date{}
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}, pdfauthor={\bookauthor}}
\input{edition-body}
